name: Peal Nock
description: Seat two strings on one bow's nocks and feel for even tension across both.

name: Squallloose
description: Rise from the court stance to a full draw in one flowing motion.

name: Sovereign Quiver
description: Nock two arrows on two strings and draw them together to a single anchor.

name: Pulsar Riser
description: Loose both strings in one release so two arrows leave a heartbeat apart.

name: Sacrosanct Vanes
description: Use both strings and the riser to catch a blade between them.

name: Sigil Anchor
description: Loose a cord arrow from each string to wrap a foe's arms from two sides.

name: Radiance Loose
description: Send twin arrows on one line with qi packed to pierce a shield and the man behind.

name: Solar Draw
description: Gather qi through both strings and loose a falling spread of paired arrows.

name: Prismanchor
description: Gather the full qi of the draw into both strings and loose a pair that sunder the guard of a heavy foe.

name: Matchless Volley
description: The school's own great shot, a paired arrow that is read by both strings and strikes one mark as a single blow.

name: Reminiscence Serving
description: Open with the shared count of the basin ranks before either archer lifts the bow.

name: Famed Limb
description: Draw in step with a partner so both strings reach full together.

name: Delugeanchor
description: Pace in time with the partner so that both lines of fire stay clear.

name: Prism Snapshot
description: Loose on the shared count so that two arrows strike one mark in one beat.

name: Splendid Arrowrest
description: Loose in alternate pairs so the rank sends a steady river of arrows at the foe.

name: Devout Bowgrip
description: Cross bows with the partner to form a screen against arrows and spears.

name: Limbtip Mercy
description: Read the fall of the partner's arrows and correct one's own aim at once.

name: Volleytriumph
description: Send one arrow to open a gap and the partner's after it through the same gap.

name: Solar Riser
description: Draw as a rank and loose a heavy wave of arrows over a wide patch of ground.

name: Prismloose
description: Gather the field of two archers into one hold and loose a pair of arrows that sunder a shield line.

name: Choral Nock
description: The school's own great shot, two archers drawing as one and loosing a single combined volley that no pair alone could send.

name: Bowstring Benison
description: Fix the eye on a point and hold it unmoved through the draw.

name: Squall Anchor
description: Draw short to the cheek for a fast close shot on the near track.

name: Loosecrown
description: Draw long behind the ear for a hard steady shot on the far track.

name: Pulsarquiver
description: Switch between near and far tracks in mid draw and loose at whichever mark opens.

name: Revelation Bowgrip
description: Pace a range with the eye alone and set the draw to it.

name: Thrallvolley
description: Pin a near foe's foot and a far foe's cloak with two quick arrows.

name: Radiance Release
description: Loose a lance of qi in a shaft along the far track to pierce plate.

name: Solar Volley
description: Gather qi in a short hold and loose a spread of arrows over a close patch of ground.

name: Prismlimb
description: Hold both tracks in one draw and loose a shaft whose force reaches the far mark intact.

name: Illustrious Limb
description: The school's own great shot, in which the archer reads two foes on two tracks and loses an arrow at each in one beat.

name: Quivergift
description: Seat the body, bow and breath on two tracks at once and hold them through the draw.

name: Ethereal Loose
description: Hold a low wide stance that stays unmoved by the recoil of a heavy draw.

name: Pulsar Arrowrest
description: Draw on the high track for a steep falling shot.

name: Illustrious Snapshot
description: Draw on the low track for a flat fast shot.

name: Prism Quiver
description: Loose on the high track and cross to the low in mid release.

name: Thrall Bowstring
description: Loose a cord arrow on the high track and a weighted arrow on the low to wrap a runner's arms and legs.

name: Vanespledge
description: Parry with the riser on one track and begin the draw on the other.

name: Gloom Serving
description: Loose a steady paired stream on both tracks at one patch of ground.

name: Exalted Limbtip
description: Send arrows on both tracks in one beat to open and then pierce a shield.

name: Solaranchor
description: Gather qi and loose a spread of paired arrows from both tracks onto a wide zone.

name: Steel Limb
description: Gather qi across both tracks into one hold and loose an arrow that parts a heavy guard.

name: Prism Release
description: The school's own great shot, a shaft loosed on both tracks at once, as the canon sets out.

name: Tranquil Vanes
description: Seat the field as the hawk perches and as the river runs below.

name: Radiance Quiver
description: Draw within the field with the high stoop of a hawk in mind and hold.

name: Nockedict
description: Loose at the pace of a river with no break between draw and release.

name: Arrowrest Decree
description: Loose a falling arrow that skims the river's length before it stoops on its mark.

name: Limbmercy
description: Spread the field over the river and read each shape on its banks.

name: Masterful Nock
description: Pin a foe's cloak and boot together with two arrows in one long motion.

name: Vacuum Limbtip
description: Send an arrow along the field's river line to pierce shield and plate.

name: Anchor Decree
description: Gather the field and loose arrows in a long fall that covers a river crossing.

name: Riser Verdict
description: Hold the field in a long draw and loose a shaft that falls with the force of a stooping hawk.

name: Magnificent Bowgrip
description: The school's own great shot, a stooping shaft that follows the river's line to its mark.

name: Illustrious Vanes
description: Draw with the Core seated in the lower body and the force sent along the arms.

name: Peal Riser
description: Feel the Core through the string and steady the nock.

name: Soundless Draw
description: Root the stance in the Core and hold it against the weight of the bow.

name: Pulsar Snapshot
description: Light the shaft with the Core's force so it flies flat and hard.

name: Volition Loose
description: Loose a stream of arrows at the pace of the Core's pulse across wide ground.

name: Serving Covenant
description: Hold the bow before the body with the Core's force in the limbs to ward off arrows.

name: Volley Pledge
description: Pin a foe's hand and foot with two arrows driven by the Core.

name: Prismdraw
description: Send a pair of Core-driven arrows along one line to pierce shield, plate and wall of boards.

name: Dunelimb
description: Gather the Core's force and loose a spread of arrows over a company.

name: Release Decree
description: Hold the Core in a long draw and loose a shaft that falls with the Core's full force.

name: Vaunted Limbtip
description: The school's own great shot, a shaft that carries the weight of a Core and strikes with the force of a formed realm.

name: Peallimb
description: Speak the short oath and seat the bow arm on the bearing of the wind.

name: Duneloose
description: Set the feet as on the plateau's edge and brace for a hard gust.

name: Dauntless Draw
description: Draw to the oath's count and hold with the wind at the back.

name: Splendid Nock
description: Loose on the oath's last word so the arrow flies along the sworn bearing.

name: Deluge Bowstring
description: Hold the bearing and turn a blade with the stave.

name: Ruling Bowgrip
description: Loose a cord arrow on the bearing to wrap a runner's legs.

name: Royal Quiver
description: Loose a lance of qi along the sworn bearing to pierce plate.

name: Quiververdict
description: Gather qi in a long hold and loose arrows that fall on the wind over a patch of ground.

name: Steelanchor
description: Hold the oath through a long draw and loose a shaft that parts a heavy guard.

name: Gallant Serving
description: The school's own great shot, sworn to the wind, in which the oath itself carries the arrow to its bearing.

name: Quivermercy
description: Name the bearing aloud to fix it in mind before the draw.

name: Spectral Release
description: Pace along the plateau's edge to keep the bearing as the foe moves.

name: Gallant Snapshot
description: Draw on the bearing and hold until the mark crosses it.

name: Anchor Triumph
description: Loose as the mark crosses the bearing line for a certain hit.

name: Royal Draw
description: Loose a steady stream of arrows along the plateau's bearing to hold open ground.

name: Loose Reliquary
description: Hook a limb tip behind a foe's ankle and pull him off the bearing.

name: Clement Limb
description: Hold the bearing and sense where an unseen foe has crossed it.

name: Prism Volley
description: Send a bearing-held arrow with qi in the head through plate.

name: Inferno Bowstring
description: Gather qi and loose a spread of arrows along several bearings over a plateau.

name: Pulsar Bowgrip
description: Hold a bearing in a long draw and loose a shaft that sunders a guard.

name: Tenet Nock
description: The school's own great shot, four arrows loosed in one chain from four bearings that all strike one mark.

name: Riserbenison
description: Speak the word under the breath and feel the gale's push on the string.

name: Thunderclap Loose
description: Draw as the gale rises and hold until it falls.

name: Vaunted Quiver
description: Loose on the last syllable of the word with qi in the shaft.

name: Radiance Bowstring
description: Curve an arrow with the gale to strike a foe sheltering behind a stone.

name: Vanesseal
description: Pluck the string at the word's end to rattle a foe's gathering of qi.

name: Vanes Covenant
description: Crouch behind the bow while the gale draws grit and thrown stone past.

name: Anchorverdict
description: Loose a heavy shaft on the sworn word with qi to pierce a shield.

name: Arrowrest Banner
description: Gather qi in a long hold and loose arrows that spread on the gale over open ground.

name: Pulsar Limb
description: Hold the gale and the word together in one draw and loose a shaft that parts a heavy guard.

name: Steelquiver
description: The school's own great shot, in which the sworn word makes the gale itself carry the arrow.

name: Revelation Serving
description: Take the rank's oath and mark the bearing of the line before the draw.

name: Spectral Anchor
description: Stand in the open rank with the feet set against the wind and the line's push.

name: Thunderclap Riser
description: Draw with the rank and hold at the call.

name: Inferno Limbtip
description: Loose on the rank's count as one voice.

name: Valiant Arrowrest
description: Loose with the rank a steady wave of arrows across open ground.

name: Pall Vanes
description: Turn the bow to take a thrust meant for a rank mate who has no wall to hold.

name: Binding Snapshot
description: Loose a cord arrow into the legs of a rider charging the open rank.

name: Vigor Vanes
description: Share the held bearing with the rank so all arrows fall on one point.

name: Radiance Volley
description: Loose a heavy shaft with the rank to pierce a board wall or a mounted foe.

name: Tempestuous Limb
description: Gather qi with the rank and loose arrows that fall on a wide stretch of open ground.

name: Pulsar Loose
description: Hold the rank's oath in a long draw and loose a shaft that breaks a heavy line.

name: Serving Verdict
description: The school's own great shot, a rank's single volley that strikes as if one archer had loosed it.

name: Limbgift
description: Spread the field and settle the bearing in it before the draw.

name: Pulsaranchor
description: Draw with the field open and the oath spoken, and hold to the last word.

name: Pulsar Draw
description: Loose within the field's lull with the wind behind the shaft.

name: Squalldraw
description: Lock the bearing in the field so the arrow keeps it through any gust.

name: Reminiscence Bowstring
description: Spread the field over open ground to read each shift of the wind.

name: Unwavering Arrowrest
description: Form the field into a veil behind the bow against arrows and thrown stone.

name: Limbtriumph
description: Loose along the locked bearing with field force enough to pierce plate.

name: Solar Release
description: Gather the field and loose a spread of arrows over a field of battle.

name: Prismriser
description: Hold the field in a long draw and loose a shaft that carries the bearing through any guard.

name: Peerless Volley
description: The school's own great shot, a shaft that holds the sworn bearing against any wind to its mark.

name: Pealvanes
description: Seat the Core and speak the oath to the gale before the draw.

name: Illustrious Release
description: Draw with the Core's force running down both arms and hold.

name: Feather Nock
description: Step on the Core's pulse to keep a held bearing as the foe moves.

name: Valiant Snapshot
description: Light a shaft with the Core's force so the wind carries it hard and flat.

name: Anchor Crown
description: Loose a steady stream of arrows at the Core's pulse across wide ground.

name: Adamant Bowgrip
description: Hold the bow before the body with the Core's force in the limbs against arrows.

name: Volleytroth
description: Pin a foe's gear with paired arrows driven by the Core.

name: Fearless Limbtip
description: Send an arrow along an oath-held bearing with the Core's force to pierce plate and board.

name: Inferno Limb
description: Gather the Core's force and loose arrows over a company on the gale.

name: Steel Limbtip
description: Hold the Core in a long draw and loose a shaft that falls with the full force of the gale.

name: Unrivaled Bowgrip
description: The school's own great shot, the oath of the gale carried by a Core's force along one sworn bearing.
